topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The flowers sit there, a vibrant, unexplained intrusion. They command attention with their silent, blooming insistence, yet offer no clues as to their origin or intent. Each petal, each stem, carries the weight of a question mark. I circle them, as if by changing my perspective, I might decipher the code of their arrival. A scent of fresh earth and something sweeter fills the air, a stark contrast to the familiar, daily scent of my space. The absence of a card only deepens the mystery. Who would send such a display without a word, a name, a hint of their thoughts? The gesture is as perplexing as it is generous, leaving me to ponder the motives behind this floral envoy.
